title: Jaipur Design Festival
short_description: Jaipur's first design festival. Three days at JKK for the people who shape the city, and the people who want to. It ends on 18 November, the day Jaipur turns 299.
description:
The Association of Designers of India

ADI is a non-profit community connecting designers, industry, students and institutions across India. Across 13 chapters, ADI creates spaces to meet, make and exchange ideas and celebrate design.

ADI has brought design communities together through festivals across India. With Pune Design Festival completing 20 years, Jaipur now joins that journey. Established in 2020, ADI Jaipur brings the city its first design festival.

13 chapters. One creative community. Now, Jaipur takes the stage.28 Speakers.
Architects, Makers, Founders, Teachers.
Visionaries leading the conversation across heritage conservation, industrial craftsmanship, circular materials, and future design systems.

description:
